assessment: RatInABox is a new python library for generating synthetic behavioral and neural data (many functional cell types) that is a highly important contribution to computational neuroscience. Critically, the authors have gone beyond the generally accepted practice with their well-written paper, documented and verified code. They show compelling evidence of its utility and usability, and this is sure to be an influential paper with implications for developing new theories and methods for joint neural and behavioral analysis beyond the navigation field.
